problem:
Find, **in ascending order and rounded to one decimal place**, the two solutions to the equation $\operatorname{sec}⁡x=-2.3$ for $0\le x<{360}^{∘}.$

**In ascending order,** the solutions are $x=$
{{field-1}}${}^{∘}$
and $x=$ 
{{field-2}}${}^{∘}.$
worked_solution:
Recall that $\operatorname{sec}⁡x=\frac{1}{\operatorname{cos}⁡x}.$ Therefore the given equation is equivalent to

$$
\operatorname{cos}⁡x=-\frac{1}{2.3}.
$$

First, we find the principal value of $x,$ rounded to three decimal places:

$$
{x}_{1}=arccos\,(-\frac{1}{2.3})≈{115.771}^{∘}
$$

Our first solution lies in the $2$nd quadrant and has a reference angle of ${\theta }_{R}≈{180}^{∘}-{115.771}^{∘}≈{64.229}^{∘}.$ Since $\operatorname{cos}⁡x<0,$ the second solution must lie in the $3$rd quadrant, and it also has a reference angle ${\theta }_{R}≈{64.229}^{∘}.$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/13977622/assets/974fad6534267df035b759df9064ed7dfaff80cb299c41744e8888f248ed1eee.png)

Since the second solution ${x}_{2}$ lies in the $3$rd quadrant, we can find it using the reference angle as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & ={180}^{∘}+{\theta }_{R} \\  & ≈{180}^{∘}+{64.229}^{∘} \\  & ≈{244.229}^{∘}\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, in ascending order and rounded to one decimal place, the solutions are $x=115.8\,{\,}^{∘}$ and $x=244.2\,{\,}^{∘}.$
